question: Umbuzo
defaultDirections: Khetha impendulo ocabanga ukuthi iphendula umbuzo. Uma usuqedile, cindezela u-{checkAnswer}. Uzothola impendulo ekhombisa ukuthi impendulo yakho ilungile yini nokuthi uqhubeke kanjani.
relatedContentDescription: Lokhu kudala indawo egoqiwe yokuqukethwe okuhlobene nalo mbuzo futhi kuhlala kuboniswa
hintDescription: Lokhu kuboniswa uma umsebenzisi ephendula kabi
evidenceDescription: Lokhu kuboniswa uma umsebenzisi ephendula kahle
crosswordDirections: Thayipha uhlamvu olulodwa esikweleni ngasinye esimhlophe. Okhiye bemicibisholo bahamba phakathi kwezikwele. Khetha isikwele futhi, noma ucindezele u-Space, ukuze ushintshe phakathi kokunqamula nokwehla. Khetha umkhondo ukuze weqele egameni lawo. Uma usuqedile, cindezela u-{checkAnswer}.
startHint: Khetha isikwele noma umkhondo ukuze uqale.
addWords: Engeza amagama nemikhondo kuzilungiselelo ukuze wakhe i-crossword. Igridi yenzelwa wena.
answerKey: Isihluthulelo sezimpendulo. Abafundi abaziboni lezi zinhlamvu.
unplacedHelp: Lawa magama akwazanga ukubekwa, ngakho abafundi ngeke bawabone. Shintsha igama ukuze labelane ngohlamvu nelinye igama, noma ulisuse.
